Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly concluded that Ambroise Thomas is not an opera composer by treating opéra comique/opéra lyrique as not opera. These are subgenres of opera; Thomas (e.g., Mignon, Hamlet) is indeed an opera composer, so both Verdi and Thomas are opera composers.
